import pytest
import ops
from ops import testing

class MyCharm(ops.CharmBase):
    def __init__(self, framework):
        super().__init__(framework)
        self.framework.observe(self.on.start, self._on_start)

    def _on_start(self, event):
        self.framework.model.get_relation('db').data[self.app]['foo'] = 'bar'

def test_relation_get_raises_relation_not_found():
    ctx = testing.Context(MyCharm, meta={'name': 'my-charm'},
                          state=testing.State(relations=[('db', {'provider'})]))
    with pytest.raises(ops.RelationNotFoundError):
        ctx.run(ctx.on.start())

import pytest
import ops
from ops import testing

class MyCharm(ops.CharmBase):
    def __init__(self, framework):
        super().__init__(framework)
        framework.observe(self.on.update_status, self._on_update_status)

    def _on_update_status(self, event):
        for relation in self.model.relations['db']:
            _ = relation.data[relation.app]

def test_relation_gone_permission_denied():
    ctx = testing.Context(MyCharm, meta={'name': 'my-charm', 'requires': {'db': {'interface': 'dummy'}}})
    state = testing.State(relations=[{'db': {'remote_app': 'provider', 'active': False}}])

    ctx.hook_tool_output = lambda *_: 'ERROR permission denied', 1

    with ctx(ctx.on.update_status(), state) as mgr:
        with pytest.raises(ops.ModelError):
            mgr.run()
